text: {"differences": [{"side": "en", "quote": "In its assessment it takes the spatial and environmental impacts into account, as well as technical aspects and the question of economic viability.", "severity": 0.2, "before": "The support group assesses the proposed corridors and recommends a planning corridor to the SFOE, together with the type of transmission technology to be used (overhead lines or underground cables)."}, {"side": "tgt", "quote": "Anschliessend bereinigt das BFE das Objektblatt und führt eine Ämterkonsultation durch.", "severity": 0.2, "before": "The SFOE then finalises the detailed plan and initiates a consultation of public authorities."}]}
